notes.title: Update 1.08.26
notes.content:
[list]
[*][b]New UI for the main PC[/b]
- New design
- Only 2 keys to control the route adjustment
[*][b]Crash fix[/b]
- Using "+/-" power-up while having no numbers available will no longer cause a crash
(guarantees a number back)
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.08.08
notes.content:
[list]
[*][b]Bug fixes and performance improvements[/b]
- Fixed a rare bug of getting stuck on antivirus screen
- VSync is now always enabled for smoother experience
- Media playback fixes
- Minor improvements
[*][b]Tutorial updated[/b]
- A bit more info about train's route
[*][b]Slight gameplay rebalance[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.07.28
notes.content:
[list]
[*][b]Decluttering UI[/b]
- Removed unnecessary text, important info is now presented as icons instead of text
[*][b]Gameplay changes[/b]
- Power outage is now avoidable - you will hear a specific sound that means you should leave any of the computers to avoid an outage
- Staying in antivirus monitor will slightly increase the scanning speed
[*][b]Updated tutorial[/b]
- More info about entities and how to deal with them in the pause menu
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.06.19
notes.content:
[list]
[*][b]Updated UI[/b]
- The route is now hidden, you can only see the station train arrives at
- Arrows instead of stations to show the direction the train is heading
- The route adjustments you make will now be displayed
[*][b]Power-ups[/b]
Introducing 5 power-ups to help you fight against the AI opponent:
- Reveal the route
- Display next station
- Show opponent's pick
- Show possible server picks
- Get a number back or lose one
[*][b]Updated tutorial[/b]
[*][b]Gameplay tweaks[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: I need your help.
notes.content:
Hi!

[h3]If you played the demo/playtest, please [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3049020/discussions/0/603030907426716508/]share your experience[/url].[/h3]

A lot of players dropped the game in the 1st round.
From what I noticed:
[list]
[*] They didn't understand the game and lost.
[*] Understood the game, won the 1st round, and were like "is that all?".
[*] People that continued the game up to round 3 or 4 ended up generally enjoying the game.
[/list]
[b]Ultimately, the 1st round is currently hit or miss, and I need your help to figure this out![/b]

[h3]Please share your experience in this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3049020/discussions/0/603030907426716508/]Steam Discussion[/url].[/h3]

Thank you!
